data.body: [P2] Preserve a way to select `main` or another named ref after pinning the default. This expression forwards non-empty dispatch values verbatim, but `opentelemetry-resolve.yml` resolves `main` only when the value is empty and rejects other non-40-character values. Since empty now selects the fixture SHA, entering the documented `main`/branch override fails before the suite runs. Resolve named refs to a SHA in the resolver, or add an explicit “use SDK main” path and describe this input as SHA-only.
